segments.text: 各位观众,今天给大家带来的是 IEEE INFOCOM 2021 的论文《Pyramid: A Layered Sharding Blockchain System》。
这篇论文由 Zicong Hong、Song Guo 等作者完成,目前已经被引用 193 次,研究方向涉及Blockchain Technology Applications and Security、Nanocluster Synthesis and Applications、Distributed systems and fault tolerance。
用论文自己的话来说:Sharding can significantly improve the blockchain scalability, by dividing nodes into small groups called shards that can handle transactions in parallel.
如果你想快速抓住重点,可以记住这几个关键词:Blockchain Technology Applications and Security、Nanocluster Synthesis and Applications、Distributed systems and fault tolerance。
